a: सेव् — {c1c} A. G. --4 To enjoy carnally; केतकीं सेवसे हंत कथं रोलंब निस्त्रपः Bv. 1. 118. --5 To attach or devote oneself to, attend to, cultivate, practise, perform; Ms. 2. 1; Ku. 5. 38, R. 17. 49. --6 To resort to, betake oneself to, dwell in, frequent, inhabit; तप्तं वारि विहाय तीरनलिनीं कारंडवः सेवते V. 2. 23, Pt. 1. 9. --7 To watch over, guard, protect.
